text:
maria_ae: Quick sync — ACME wants a 6‑week POC, target start Apr 7. Need to align on SE/eng resourcing, pricing ask, and security questionnaire. Success criteria they care about: 1) 95th pctl latency < 600ms for gen calls, 2) embedding recall >= 0.88 on their eval set, 3) cost per 1M tokens under $1800 (ballpark). @sam_se can you confirm SE availability? Also we need to lock prompts/evals and an initial data ingest plan.

sam_se: I can lead SE for first 3 weeks full time, then taper to 1d/wk. Need access to their sample dataset by Wed. Will set up a stub endpoint for integration testing. Can we get a dev Dedicated slot for load tests? :+1:

nora_pm: Proposed milestone split:
```
Week 0 (prep): NDA, questionnaire, sample data
Week 1: Kickoff, data ingestion + sanity checks
Week 2: Prompt curation + eval harness
Week 3: Latency/load testing + batching config
Week 4: Optimization + regression checks
Week 5: Canary with limited traffic
Week 6: Hand-off, docs, exec review
```
Owners: SE=Sam, Eng=Oliver, Security=Lea, PM=Nora. Deliverables: data ingestion script, eval set & baseline, performance runbook, cost model.

oliver_eng: FYI — custom S3 connector will take ~2 dev days. If timeboxed we can use CSV push (customer uploads) as interim. Need a ticket with access details. Also: we'll need an allowlist for the test cluster IPs.

lea_security: I'll own the questionnaire. Short list:
- Is customer data stored? (yes/no)
- KMS/HSM required? (they asked yes)
- SOC2 / ISO reqs? (they requested SOC2)
I'll upload our completed questionnaire here: https://internal.redwood/security/qnrs/acme-poc
Also we need contact for their infosec — @maria_ae please share.

ellen_salesops: Pricing check — can offer 30% trial credit for POC (up to $25k) + we can give 2 weeks free Dedicated dev slot. For final pricing they want committed baseline — will push options post POC. @maria_ae confirm deal anchor.

maria_ae: Thanks — please do the uploads. I'll get the sample data and infosec contact today. Two open asks: 1) Sam/Oliver confirm dev Dedicated slot by EOD tomorrow; 2) Lea to return questionnaire in 3 business days. If we hit these, client expects go/no-go at end of Week 2. I'll update ACME.

sam_se: Confirmed on Dedicated dev slot — provisional approved, need SalesOps to finalize resource code.

ellen_salesops: Added resource code and trial credit notes to the deal in SFDC.

deploy-bot: Note: test cluster provisioned at 1905012800 by infra-bot.

nora_pm: I'll circulate a short 1‑page runbook and the eval prompt set by COB tomorrow. :calendar:

maria_ae: Great, thanks everyone. I'll post a brief summary to the customer after we close the questionnaire and sample data inbound. :rocket:
